title: A lawsuit says Oura’s sleep stages are AI guesses with a coin flip’s odds
summary: A proposed class action filed in San Francisco alleges Oura’s sleep staging is generated by AI estimates rather than measurement, and names Finnish parent Oura Health Oy as a defendant.
